summary: The PR correctly implements the two required functions for scope intersection and validation, passing all unit tests and preserving legacy behavior.
key_findings: narrow_scopes correctly returns a sorted, deduplicated list of scopes present in both requested and granted sets.
has_all_required_scopes correctly checks if all required scopes are present in the token scopes.
Legacy function parse_scope_header remains unchanged and its test passes.
Type hints use modern union syntax (list[str] | set[str]) which is valid in Python 3.10+.
